name: Onyx (formerly Danswer)
description: Self-hosted knowledge layer and AI chat that indexes 50+ workplace apps and answers with that context.
whatItDoes: Connects to a team's applications, indexes their content with metadata and permissions, and lets people or agents search and chat over it. It also offers web search, sandboxes and skills on top of search.
howItWorks: Connectors pull documents into an internal index so queries are answered from a pre-built representation rather than live fan-out. A web UI and backend are deployed together with a single install script. Code outside the ee directories is MIT licensed; ee directories use a separate enterprise licence.
